jiahao.quote.perfect_dodge.6: Were you just... trying to touch me?
jiahao.quote.manual.6: A true master never looks back.
jiahao.quote.manual.8: What you see is only an afterimage.
jiahao.quote.transform.2: As expected, the rain suits me better.
jiahao.quote.transform.3: From now on, don't disturb me.
jiahao.quote.transform.4: The world feels a little quieter now.
jiahao.quote.low_health.4: Looks like I need to get serious.

jiahao.quote.special.transform_revenge: Isn’t it time to settle the grudge from ten years ago?
jiahao.quote.special.time_stop_notice: Be careful — time has not truly stopped.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.1: Some things only become clear when you stand high enough.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.2: You see the result. I see the process.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.3: The rain did not fall for me. It just happened to find me.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.4: Silence does not always mean there is no answer.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.5: I stopped. That does not mean the world did.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.6: Some people chase time. I wait for it.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.7: What truly matters never needs explaining.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.8: Some paths look untouched. You simply cannot see who walks them.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.9: Which way the wind blows does not matter.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.10: I did not look back. The world just passed behind me.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.11: You are not ready to understand yet.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.13: This is not the end. It is the quiet before the beginning.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.14: Time will prove many things. I do not need to wait.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.17: Sometimes, the faster you move, the stiller you seem.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.18: Real change often makes no sound.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.19: If you understand, you do not need my explanation.
jiahao.quote.random_moment.20: I am not showing off. I am just maintaining my form.
jiahao.quote.market.1: The market does not lie. It sorts people out.
jiahao.quote.market.3: Red and green are just colors to ordinary people.
jiahao.quote.market.4: I am reading human nature, not the chart.
jiahao.quote.market.5: Falling numbers do not mean I lost.
jiahao.quote.market.6: The real profit lies beyond the chart.
jiahao.quote.market.7: Others see risk. I see direction.
jiahao.quote.market.8: By the time everyone understands, it is already too late.
jiahao.quote.market.9: The market has not changed. You have started to fear it.
jiahao.quote.code.1: Code does not make mistakes. The people interpreting it do.
jiahao.quote.code.2: A true program does not need to run.
jiahao.quote.code.3: By the time you see the result, the program has long finished.
jiahao.quote.code.4: A bug is just the system misunderstanding me.
jiahao.quote.code.5: Others write code. I rewrite the rules.
jiahao.quote.code.6: No errors does not mean no problems.
jiahao.quote.code.7: I am not debugging. I am watching the system repair itself.
jiahao.quote.code.8: If the code looks complicated, you are not standing high enough.
jiahao.quote.code.9: A successful compilation is the most ordinary outcome.
jiahao.quote.code.10: I am entering answers, not commands.
jiahao.quote.code.11: Permission? I do not need permission.
jiahao.quote.code.12: The system has not refused. It has not understood yet.

jiahao.quote.hao_burst.1: Hao is not something you calculate.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.2: Even time needs a moment to think about this.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.3: You think I stopped. The world just could not keep up.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.4: Sometimes having no meaning is the greatest meaning of all.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.5: Today's rain is just the backdrop.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.7: I am not striking a pose. I am waiting for the world to understand.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.8: At a certain speed, standing still is another way forward.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.9: If this seems strange, you have not entered the right state yet.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.10: This second is taking its time.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.11: I did not change time. Time changed its attitude.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.12: Some people hurry down the road. I wait for the road to come to me.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.13: You see a pose. I see a checkpoint.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.14: True Hao does not have to make sense.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.15: I am already standing in the next second.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.16: Hold that thought. Let the camera finish.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.17: Time has not stopped. It just does not dare move yet.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.18: The real question is not what I am doing. It is why you are watching.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.19: This is not a pose. It is a state of being.
jiahao.quote.hao_burst.20: Do not try to understand. Just feel it.

jiahao.quote.market.14: Today's trend knows how to behave.
